tabs.node: Errors, traces and logs from {'@'}sentry/node; emails from nodemailer or any SMTP client; webhooks you send, captured as HTTP dumps.
tabs.browser: Errors, page-load traces and logs from {'@'}sentry/browser. No CORS setup: by default Buggregator accepts requests from any origin (CORS_ORIGINS limits it).
tabs.python: Errors, traces and logs from sentry-python (Django included: the SDK turns its Django integration on by itself); emails from any SMTP client.
tabs.go: Errors, traces and logs from sentry-go; emails from any SMTP client; outgoing HTTP calls through the debug proxy.
tabs.java: Errors, traces and logs from the Sentry Java SDK (io.sentry 8.64 checked); emails from Spring Mail or any SMTP client; HTTP requests and webhooks as dumps; mock APIs under /mock/.
tabs.otel: Traces and logs from any OpenTelemetry SDK, or from the OTel Collector with the otlphttp exporter. Sent over OTLP/HTTP to port 8000, shown in Sentry Traces and Logs with an OTel label. Not accepted: gRPC (port 4317) and metrics.

trap.title: Debugging functions for your PHP code
trap.description: A Composer package with trap(), tr() and td() — drop-in replacements for dump() and dd(). Chain .depth(), .once(), .if() to dump only what you need. Call tr() between two lines to see the time and memory spent. Works on its own or with the full server.

jetbrains.title: Never leave your IDE
jetbrains.description: The Buggregator plugin for PhpStorm brings dumps, logs, and debug data directly into your editor.

testo.title: Tests without the boilerplate
testo.description: Testo is a PHP testing framework. Write tests as classes, plain functions or attributes right on your code — no TestCase to extend. Assertions grouped by type, benchmarks with one {attr} attribute, and a PhpStorm plugin. PHP 8.2+, now in open beta.

whatsNew.title: One request on one screen, and every queue job

timeline.title: Everything one request did
timeline.desc: Open a Sentry trace and see its SQL queries, cache calls, logs, mails, outgoing calls, jobs and errors on one time scale. When the same query runs five times or more, a hint names it and, when the SDK sends it, the file and line: the classic N+1.

queues.title: Queue jobs, attempt by attempt
queues.desc: Sentry → Queues lists the jobs your Laravel worker ran: which failed, how many attempts they took, the exception of each attempt, how long they waited, and the request that queued them.

logs.title: A Logs screen with search
logs.desc: All Monolog lines as one live stream, like tail -f with search. Filter by level, channel and time, see lines per minute on a chart, pause to read, and open all lines of one request.

filters.title: Feed filters for a shared server
filters.desc: One Buggregator for the whole team? Show only your machine’s events, or one environment, user, Monolog channel, level, release or tag. The filters go into the link you share.
